name: rig
description: Rig project config for the CLI, daemon, and Git remote helper binaries.

rig.build: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile rig

rigd.build: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun build --compile src/rigd.ts --outfile rigd

git-remote-rig.build: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun build --compile src/git/remote-helper.ts --outfile git-remote-rig
